# Vulnerability / Topic

Formatting & analysis of a one-liner program

# Theme

Formatting a program written in C#

# Expected solver's thought process

1. Open with VSCode or similar.
2. Add line breaks and indentation in appropriate places.
3. Realize that the `flag` is 35 characters long and is checked one character at a time.
(This can be solved instantly by providing it to generative AI.)

# Expected Difficulty

Beginners

## solution

It is very difficult to read, but after formatting, it looks like this:

```csharp
using System;
class Program {
  static void Main() {
    int len=0x23;
    Console.Write("INPUT > ");
    string flag=Console.ReadLine();
    if((flag.Length)!=len){Console.WriteLine("WRONG!");}else{
        if(
            flag[0]==0x63&&
            flag[1]==0x74&&
            flag[2]==0x66&&
            flag[3]==0x34&&
            flag[4]==0x62&&
            flag[5]==0x7b&&
            flag[6]==0x31&&
            flag[7]==0x5f&&
            flag[8]==0x31&&
            flag[9]==0x69&&
            flag[10]==0x6e&&
            flag[11]==0x33&&
            flag[12]==0x72&&
            flag[13]==0x35&&
            flag[14]==0x5f&&
            flag[15]==0x6d&&
            flag[16]==0x61&&
            flag[17]==0x6b&&
            flag[18]==0x33&&
            flag[19]==0x5f&&
            flag[20]==0x50&&
            flag[21]==0x47&&
            flag[22]==0x5f&&
            flag[23]==0x68&&
            flag[24]==0x61&&
            flag[25]==0x72&&
            flag[26]==0x64&&
            flag[27]==0x5f&&
            flag[28]==0x32&&
            flag[29]==0x5f&&
            flag[30]==0x72&&
            flag[31]==0x33&&
            flag[32]==0x61&&
            flag[33]==0x64&&
            flag[34]==0x7d){
                Console.WriteLine("YES!!!\nThis is Flag :)");
                
            }else{Console.WriteLine("WRONG!");}
    }
  }
}
```

The code references the 35-character `flag` one character at a time.
